events.name: Cape Town Cycle Tour
events.description: The world's largest timed cycle race (~35 000 riders). Road closures sweep the CBD, Sea Point, Camps Bay and the Peninsula from early morning.

events.name: Two Oceans Marathon
events.description: Ultra (56 km) on Easter Saturday and Half (21 km) on Easter Sunday. Closures through the southern suburbs and the peninsula.

events.name: Sanlam Cape Town Marathon
events.description: City-centre marathon (IAAF-labelled). Road closures around Green Point, Sea Point, the CBD and southern suburbs.

events.name: Absa Cape Epic
events.description: Eight-day mountain-bike stage race across the Western Cape; the start and finish stages disrupt local traffic.

events.name: The Gun Run
events.description: Half marathon and 10 km along the Atlantic seaboard. Closures on Green Point, Sea Point and Mouille Point roads.

events.name: Cape Town Carnival
events.description: Night-time street parade on the Green Point Fan Walk. Somerset Road and the surrounding streets close for the evening.

events.name: Cape Town Pride Parade
events.description: Pride march and festival through Green Point, Sea Point and De Waterkant.

events.name: Minstrel Carnival (Kaapse Klopse)
events.description: The Cape Town Minstrel Carnival (Kaapse Klopse), a large minstrel festival held annually on 2 January. The parade moves through the CBD, Bo-Kaap and Green Point, closing Somerset Road and Green Point Main Road for the day.

events.name: V&A Waterfront New Year's Eve
events.description: New Year's Eve fireworks and crowds at the V&A Waterfront. Congestion on Green Point Main Road, Beach Road, Helen Suzman Boulevard and Somerset Road.

events.name: Investing in African Mining Indaba
events.description: Africa's largest mining investment conference at the CTICC (7 000+ delegates: ministers, mining houses, financiers). Heavy congestion around the Foreshore and CBD for the week.

events.name: Knysna Cycle Tour
events.description: Mountain-bike and road cycle races around Knysna on the Garden Route.
